deadline.value: Graduate Teaching Fellowship (GTF) funding applications for Fall are due April 1, 2027 (inferred from annual 'APRIL 1st'; Spring GTF: October 31). Admission itself is rolling until 1 week before Fall 2027 classes (August 16, 2027 on GS page; 60 days prior recommended for international/document processing); Graduate School First-Year Fellowship nominations close February 15.
deadline.quote: Applications for GTF positions are due APRIL 1st for the Fall semester and OCTOBER 31st for the Spring semester.

also.quote: Completed applications (including all supporting documentation) should be submitted 60 days prior to the term for which admission is sought. However, applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and will be considered if this deadline is not met.

gre_general.value: GRE General Test taken within the last 2 years is required (for non-UCCS students), with >= 80th percentile Quantitative recommended.
gre_general.quote: Submit GRE General Test scores, taken within the last 2 years, with a recommended percentile of 80 or higher on the Quantitative Reasoning section.

also.quote: Scores from the GRE General Test, taken within the last 2 years (for Spring 2022 or later admission)

gre_subject.value: Department and Graduate School pages list only the GRE General Test and do not state any policy on the ETS Mathematics Subject Test.

supervisor.value: Admission decisions are made individually by the Mathematics Graduate Committee; prospective applicants are encouraged to review faculty research interests and contact faculty to discuss mentorship.
supervisor.quote: decisions regarding admission are made on an individual basis by the Graduate Committee.

also.quote: For more information or to discuss mentorship, please see our research interests and contact faculty directly.

funding.value: A limited number of competitive Graduate Teaching Fellowships (GTFs) provide a tuition grant and teaching pay (renewable annually based on performance; apply by April 1 for Fall), alongside competitive Graduate School PhD Grants (up to $26,000/yr) and Tuition Matching Grants (up to $8,000/yr).
funding.quote: For students enrolled in the mathematics M.S. and Ph.D. programs, the department offers a limited number of Graduate Teaching Fellowships (GTF's). Each GTF receives a tuition grant and pay for teaching. | Applications for GTF positions are due APRIL 1st for the Fall semester

also.quote: A limited number of scholarships are available each year from the Department of Mathematics to provide financial support to students enrolled in the PhD program.

entry_route.value: Requires a bachelor's degree in mathematics or a related field with significant math coursework (>= 3.0 overall and math GPA); up to 25% of the 60 required credits may be transferred from prior graduate or MS coursework.
entry_route.quote: Holding a baccalaureate degree in mathematics or a related field with significant math coursework from an accredited college or university | The total hours of graduate coursework and dissertation work applied to the degree must be 60. This total may include coursework applied toward a Master's degree.

notes: Official degree track is Applied Science: Mathematics, Ph.D., spanning probability and statistics, differential equations, applied analysis, algebra, and coding theory. Department English page confirms TOEFL 80 (legacy web scale) / IELTS 6.5 / Duolingo 105 (note GS updated chart lists 4.5 on the 1-6 scale effective 1/21/2026 and Duolingo 115) and defers exemptions to UCCS admissions policy. Conditional admission is NOT granted for applicants not meeting English proficiency requirements.
name: Applied Science: Mathematics, Ph.D.
